fields.System.Title: RET-201 — Receive against an RMA
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a returns clerk, I want to record what physically came back against an RMA, so that
the return is tracked from the moment it arrives.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an open RMA, when I scan products and enter quantities, then a return receipt
  • is created.
  • - Given a quantity above the RMA's outstanding amount, then it is rejected or requires
  • approval.
  • - Given a product not on the RMA, then it is recorded as an unexpected item requiring
  • investigation.
  • - Given the same return receipt confirmed twice with one idempotency key, then stock is
  • created once.
  • - Given confirmation, then returns.return_received is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory |
| Tables | return_receipt, return_line, rma |
| Risks | Return processed twice ([doc 09 §8.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · idempotency · rollback |
